notes.text: Returns notification preferences for the selected cPanel or Webmail account. The pinned operation declares x-readonly=true and no minimum version; this read changes no preference.

Rows preserve optional descp, name, enabled and the literal string field additionalProperties declared under properties in the pinned schema. This does not establish arbitrary dynamic preference fields. enabled remains integer 0 or 1; omitted row fields remain absent, and an empty list remains empty.

notes.text: Available in cPanel 130 and later. The source marks this retrieval x-readonly=false and no rollback, so it uses POST despite its get prefix.

Returns the selected cPanel account's Pushbullet access token as sensitive payload data. Keep returned tokens out of logs and evidence; this operation is excluded from the bounded live catalog. Empty strings remain strings; null or absent data is not a token.

evidence.note: Pinned /ContactInformation/set_email_addresses declares x-readonly=false and x-rollback=none. Use form POST, retaining any credentials outside query strings. The address and old_address arrays declare explode=true with string items. Send duplicate address or old_address keys using the repeat encoder. The source marks all listed parameters required=true, including the sensitive account password; the evidence-bound old_address exception below does not change the required new addresses or password.

Claude PR41 review https://github.com/hostingpal/whm-api-client/pull/41#pullrequestreview-5720241923 observed first-contact creation through direct UAPI and the WHM bridge on disposable account wrvenv. With no current contacts, omitting old_address in a generic form POST succeeded with data:null; an empty list was rejected locally and an empty string failed at the API. With existing contacts, omission failed the existing-address comparison and left contacts unchanged. Make only this setter's old_address omittable; supplied values retain repeated-key encoding and race-check semantics. The required complete old_address list for unset_email_addresses is unchanged: a partial list failed and the full list succeeded on both routes. Reviewer cleanup confirmed account removal after each run; these observations are separate from committed read-only capture evidence.

old_address.description: The account's complete existing contact email address list. Supply it when contacts exist; a mismatch fails to prevent races. Omit this argument (or pass null) only when adding the first addresses to an account with no current contacts, as observed on cPanel 11.138.0.19 through direct UAPI and the WHM bridge. Omission does not bypass the existing-address check. Empty lists are rejected locally; an empty string was rejected by the API.

notes.text: Available in cPanel 102 and later. Sets the selected account's contact email addresses with no rollback. Use unsetEmailAddresses() to remove all addresses.

Supply the new addresses and account password. When contacts exist, supply their complete list as oldAddresses; a mismatch fails to prevent races. Repeated keys preserve supplied address order. This changes contact destinations; the client does not send a separate notification.

On cPanel 11.138.0.19, direct UAPI and WHM-bridged form POSTs accepted omitted old_address when setting the first contacts and returned data:null. Omit oldAddresses (or pass null) only when no contacts exist; omission with existing contacts failed without changing them. An empty list fails local validation and an empty string failed at the API. The account password remains required and sensitive. This setter exception does not change unsetEmailAddresses(), which requires the complete existing-address list.
The pinned success envelope declares no data member; this operation returns void after checking the envelope outcome.

exclude.reason: Requires an application/json request body; typed JSON-body support remains tracked under whm-api-client-8x0.1.18. Raw callJson() supplies no typed contract and establishes no endpoint compatibility.

notes.text: Available in cPanel 102 and later. Removes all contact email addresses from the selected account with no rollback. This changes the account's contact destinations.

Supply the complete existing-address list and the account password. A mismatched oldAddresses list fails to prevent races. Both arguments remain required, and the nonempty list is encoded as repeated old_address keys in caller order.
The pinned success envelope declares no data member; this operation returns void after checking the envelope outcome.
